policy.label: Basel: BVB/BLT and Swiss-side regional rail

roadExclusions.note: The 50 m station-candidate profile doubles back along the approach from the provisional General Guisan-Strasse stop. The official plan instead continues around the southern loop to St. Galler-Ring. Do not accept the shortcut.

exclusions: Long-distance and regional-express rail; S5, S9, RB27 and RB30
Rail calls beyond Laufen, Sissach, Rheinfelden, Riehen and Basel St. Johann
Other local operators, including AAGL, SWEG and distribus; this is not complete TNW or trireno

scope.sourceCallSemantics: Every local source call retained; rail keeps contiguous in-scope source calls only, with zero-based half-open sourceCallRange and full sourceCallCount. No calendar or coordinate clipping hides intermediate calls.

infrastructure.inference: Undirected physical centreline corridors through exact FOT operating-point identities. Running tracks are not resolved.
